subject: MSA + Order Form: clarity on output ownership, training opt-in, and feedback license (evidence & escrow)
messages:
From: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@novum.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@novum.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@novum.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on draft MSA + Order Form (output use & training)

Hi Sean,

Thanks for sending over the MSA + order form. Our legal team has a few open items we need clarified before we can proceed to procurement:

1) Output ownership: the current order form language appears to grant us a license to use model outputs, but it also includes references to "productization" that our product team flagged. We need explicit confirmation whether Redwood claims any ownership in customer-provided prompts or in downstream app artifacts derived from outputs.

2) Training / feedback license: the MSA has a feedback clause that lets Redwood use user feedback to improve models. We want a scoped, opt-in mechanism and a clear data handling/evidence process for any training.

3) Evidence for SOC2 / telemetry: our auditors will want a one-page evidence sheet showing telemetry retention, audit log access, and whether any model retraining would use our customer data. I attached a template.

Can you point us to the recommended redline positions and whether Redwood can offer an escrow/third-party audit commitment around use of customer data for retraining?

Appreciate a quick sync. We are aiming to finalize commercial terms by the end of the month.

Thanks,
Pamela Ortiz
Head of Legal, Novum Analytics

Attachments: Evidence_Sheet_SOC2.xlsx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@novum.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on draft MSA + Order Form (output use & training)

Hi Pamela — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then proposed next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Output ownership: Redwood does not claim ownership of customer-provided prompts or unique downstream artifacts the customer chooses to retain or productize. The order form uses "license to use outputs" language to allow operational debugging and analytics; we can add explicit carveouts for customer product artifacts and clearly exclude customer PII.
- Training / feedback: we can offer a scoped feedback license (opt-in) and an "opt-out by default" clause for training on customer data. For customers who opt in, Redwood will provide a notice of model retraining windows and an evidence package.
- Evidence / escrow: we do not currently offer model-weight escrow, but we can provide contractual audit rights and a commitment to provide SOC2 telemetry extracts and a third-party attestation for retrain events.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll attach a marked-up order form with two redline options: (A) productization carveout + training opt-in, (B) limited feedback license + telemetry attestation.
2) Legal-to-legal call this week to walk the redlines — Laura can lead the call on Redwood's side.
3) Provide the evidence sheet (SOC2) and an outline of the retrain-notice process for your auditors.

I'll circulate the redlines by EOD today. If Novum prefers a single combined approach rather than two options, let us know which is higher priority (no training vs no productization exposure).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_orderform_20271013.docx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@novum.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Questions on draft MSA + Order Form (output use & training)

Pamela — looping in legal posture and proposed contract language below. I reviewed Novum's template and prepared conservative redlines that should be acceptable to procurement and your product team. Key excerpts: 

- Output ownership carveout (proposed): "Customer retains exclusive ownership of Customer Content and any Derivative Works created solely from Customer Content and Customer Outputs; Redwood grants Customer a perpetual, royalty-free license to Customer Outputs solely for Customer's internal and productization purposes."

- Training/feedback (proposed): "Redwood will not use Customer Content or Customer Outputs to train, fine-tune, or improve any model unless Customer provides explicit, written opt-in. For customers that opt in, Redwood will: (i) notify Customer at least 30 days before commencing any training that uses Customer Content; (ii) provide a summary of data used and a post-training attestation describing controls; (iii) allow Customer to request deletion of Customer Content from the training corpus within 60 days in certain circumstances."

- Audit & evidence: "Redwood will provide SOC2 audit artifacts, telemetry slices, and a retrain attestation on request. For high-sensitivity customers, Redwood will agree to a limited third-party attestation around retrain events; model weight escrow is available subject to separate SOW and cost schedule."

I attached the redline doc (option B is our recommended starting point). If Novum needs an even more restrictive opt-in (e.g., no productization + no training), we can escalate to legal for a tailored SLA and pricing adjustment.

Action items: 
- Pamela / Novum Legal: confirm whether you want the training opt-in or a flat opt-out.
- Sean: confirm commercial impact if Novum requires model-weight escrow or a separate attestation SOW (rough order of magnitude).

Thanks — happy to hop on a call.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Pamela — following up after Laura's redlines. A few practical notes from commercial side: 

- Opt-in route (recommended): No commercial impact for a standard opt-in where Novum explicitly flags datasets they are comfortable contributing. We will include the 30-day notice and attestation at no extra cost.

- Escrow / attestation SOW: If Novum requires model-weight escrow or an on-site third-party attestation beyond standard SOC2 artifacts, that will be priced as a separate SOW. Ballpark: $40k–$75k depending on scope and auditor travel.

- Timeline: if Novum confirms opt-in by 10/21 we can finalize the order form and begin onboarding 11/01. If you require escrow/SOW we should factor in an extra 3–6 weeks.

Next steps:
- Pamela: reply with "opt-in" or "require-escrow" preference.
- Laura / Aditya: prepare formal attestation language and update the HubSpot deal with pricing delta for escrow.

Thanks — happy to take a short legal/ops call tomorrow if helpful.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
